@lru_cache(maxsize=1024 * 128)
def _path_to_elements(path, root_element=DEFAULT_FIRST_ELEMENT):
    elements = []
    if root_element:
        elements.append(root_element)
    
    if not path or path == 'root':
        return elements
    
    # Remove 'root' prefix if present
    if path.startswith('root'):
        path = path[4:]
    
    if not path:
        return elements
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(path):
        if path[i] == '[':
            # Find the closing bracket, handling quoted strings
            j = i + 1
            in_quote = False
            quote_char = None
            while j < len(path):
                if path[j] in {'"', "'"} and (j == 0 or path[j-1] != '\\'):
                    if not in_quote:
                        in_quote = True
                        quote_char = path[j]
                    elif path[j] == quote_char:
                        in_quote = False
                        quote_char = None
                elif path[j] == ']' and not in_quote:
                    break
                j += 1
            
            elem = path[i+1:j]
            _add_to_elements(elements, elem, '[')
            i = j + 1
        elif path[i] == '.':
            # Find the next bracket or dot or end
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(path) and path[j] not in {'.', '['}:
                j += 1
            elem = path[i+1:j]
            _add_to_elements(elements, elem, '.')
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    
    return elements
